chapters.label: Discover
chapters.head: Everything about the mattress, topic by topic.

blocks.t: **Baby Cot Size** is made for cots and cot beds. **Junior Size** is made for junior and single beds. Every size has the same core, the same Medium firmness and the same cotton cover.
Each mattress is made to order, in the size and depth you choose in **Select & Buy**.
Cot and bed sizes differ between manufacturers. Measure the **inside** of the frame, length and width, and check the maximum mattress depth your cot or bed allows.

panels.label: Honest Promise
panels.title: What we say, and what we do not

blocks.t: One piece of 100% natural Dunlop latex with ventilation channels, inside a quilted 100% cotton cover with a zip along the side. Medium firmness. Made to order in the size and depth you select.
We do not say this mattress suits every cot, and we make no medical claims. Always follow current guidance from the NHS and The Lullaby Trust, together with the instructions supplied with your cot.

panels.label: From Tree To Foam
panels.title: Where natural latex begins
text: Natural latex starts as the **milk of the rubber tree**, a renewable plant. It is gathered, and **Dunlop Technology** turns it into foam.
In the film, the milk flows, gathers and is poured into the shape that becomes the core of the mattress.

items.d: Natural latex comes from the rubber tree. Memory foam, HR foam and standard polyurethane foam are made from refined petroleum.
The tree is tapped for its milk, and keeps growing.
The core is moulded as a single piece of 100% natural latex, with no glued layers.
Latex foam is open-celled, so air can move through it.

panels.label: Dunlop Technology
panels.title: One piece, made with Dunlop Technology

blocks.t: The core is made with **Dunlop Technology** as one moulded block, with rows of ventilation channels formed in it during moulding.
Because it is one piece, there are no glued layers to separate and nothing hidden inside that you cannot see: open the zip and the whole core is in view.

chapters.label: Healthy
chapters.head: A healthy place to sleep starts with the surface.

panels.label: What Healthy Means
panels.title: What a healthy sleep surface is made of

items.d: 100% natural Dunlop latex, from the rubber tree, moulded as one piece.
An open-cell structure with ventilation channels lets air move through the core instead of being held at the surface.
A quilted cover of 100% cotton, a natural plant fibre.
The cover opens along the side with a zip, so the core can be seen and checked.

groups.h: Why air matters for a child

blocks.t: Children sleep warm, and every night leaves some warmth and moisture behind. A core that lets air move through it, instead of holding it at the surface, keeps the sleeping surface fresher and drier.
A mattress is not a climate control system: the room matters most. What ventilation genuinely does is stop warmth and moisture being trapped inside the mattress.
Natural latex is dense and elastic. It carries the body evenly across the surface and answers every movement at once, without a slow recovery.
The mattress is made in one firmness, **Medium**, in every size and depth.

panels.label: Honest Note
panels.title: A whole environment, not one product

blocks.t: A healthy night's sleep for a baby or child depends on the whole sleep environment: the cot, the bedding, the room temperature and the way the child is put down to sleep.
This mattress is not a medical device and we make no medical claims. Always follow current guidance from the **NHS** and **The Lullaby Trust**, together with the instructions supplied with your cot.

chapters.label: Comfort
chapters.head: What comfort to expect from natural latex.

blocks.t: Natural latex keeps the body **on the surface** and still follows its shape. It is the balance between **support** and **adaptation** that makes latex feel the way it does.
You feel lightness and softness on top, and steady support underneath: a natural material, used with engineering precision.

items.d: Latex is very dense, almost twice as dense as many foams used in mattresses. That density carries the body without a hard surface.
The body rests on the mattress rather than sinking into a hollow that closes around it.
Because the body is held up, turning over takes little effort.
A dense, elastic material keeps its shape under repeated use.
No delay and no warming-up: the latex answers the moment the body touches it.
The load is shared across the whole surface instead of concentrating in one spot.
Every small movement in sleep is absorbed and answered as it happens.
The surface resets at once, unlike foams that recover slowly.

chapters.label: Benefits
chapters.head: Why natural latex is a different kind of material.

items.d: Latex responds at once and does not wrap around the body or recover slowly.
No coils: a continuous, silent, even surface across the whole mattress.
Tapped from a renewable plant, and not made from petroleum.

items.t: One piece, made with Dunlop Technology
items.d: A single moulded block with ventilation channels and no glued layers.

panels.label: Made To Last
panels.title: A material that keeps its shape

blocks.t: Latex is dense and elastic, and a dense, elastic material keeps its shape and its response under repeated use.
Because the core is one piece, it does not rely on layers that can separate.

chapters.label: Ventilation
chapters.head: How air moves through the core.

panels.label: Airflow
panels.title: Air moving through the latex
text: The open-cell structure of natural latex, together with the **ventilation channels** formed in the core, lets air move through the mattress.
This is a structural feature of the material, not a surface treatment.

panels.label: How It Works
panels.title: From the structure to a fresher surface
panels.close: Ventilation does not cool the room. It stops warmth and moisture from being trapped inside the mattress.

panels.label: Cleaner Sleep
panels.title: Built to stay clean and dry

items.d: Airflow through the open-cell core keeps the surface drier than a closed foam would.
The zip opens the cover along the side, so the core can be seen and checked.
One moulded block: there are no glued layers to trap anything between them.

blocks.t: No mattress completely eliminates dust or bacteria. A dry, ventilated structure with a cover you can open is a sound starting point, and the rest is everyday care.
Follow the care instructions supplied with your mattress, and use a fitted sheet made for the exact mattress size.

panels.label: 100% Cotton
panels.title: 100% cotton, quilted in wide waves
text: The cover is **100% cotton**, a natural fibre. It is quilted in wide transverse waves and closes with a zip along the side, so the core inside can be seen.
The cover and the latex core are made together as one mattress: the cover is not a separate choice.

blocks.t: A zip runs along the side, so the cover opens and the one-piece latex core inside can be seen and checked.
Follow the care instructions supplied with your mattress.
Every Baby & Junior mattress has the same cover: **100% cotton**, quilted in wide transverse waves, with a zip along the side. There is nothing to select, so it is simply part of every order.

chapters.label: Firmness
chapters.head: One firmness for the whole range.

blocks.t: The Baby & Junior range is made in a single firmness, **Medium**, in every size and depth. There is nothing to select.

panels.label: Not Weight-Based
panels.title: Why there is no firmness choice

blocks.t: Our adult, weight-based firmness recommendations do not apply to babies and children and are not used for this range.
Cot and bed sizes differ between manufacturers. The right mattress is the one that matches the inside of your frame.

t: **Measure inside.** Length and width of the cot or bed frame, not the outside.
**Match the size.** It should fit snugly, with no gaps at the sides or ends.
**Check the depth.** Many cots state a maximum mattress height: choose a depth within it.
**Follow your cot.** Use its instructions on mattress size and maximum height.

panels.label: Before Use
panels.title: Before it goes in the cot

t: **Unpacking.** Remove all packaging, including any plastic wrapping, before use, and keep it away from children.
**Bedding.** Use a fitted sheet made for the exact mattress size. Keep the sleeping surface flat and clear.
**Cover.** Follow the care instructions supplied with your mattress.

blocks.t: If anyone in your household has a latex allergy, please seek medical advice before purchase.
Always follow current guidance from the NHS and The Lullaby Trust, together with the instructions supplied with your cot.
